$comment: Org-wide issue label taxonomy. Reference data only — `standards apply` does not create labels. See README.md#label-taxonomy for how to apply and migrate them.

labels.name: type:chore
labels.description: Maintenance: tooling, CI, refactoring, release plumbing.

labels.name: priority:P0
labels.description: Drop everything: data loss, security, or main is broken.

labels.name: priority:P1
labels.description: Next up: blocks users or the next release.

labels.name: priority:P2
labels.description: Scheduled: planned work without a hard deadline.

labels.name: priority:P3
labels.description: Backlog: nice to have, no commitment.

labels.name: epic
labels.description: Tracking issue that groups related work. Title convention: `Epic: …`.

labels.name: cross-repo
labels.description: Work that spans more than one repository in the org.

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: Good entry point for a first contribution.

labels.name: dependencies
labels.description: Dependency updates. Renovate applies this label.

labels.name: question
labels.description: Usage or contributor question. Applied by the Question issue form.

labels.name: standards:needs-agent
labels.description: Standards drift PR with open judgement steps — see SKILL.md.

labels.name: standards:needs-review
labels.description: Standards drift PR awaiting the semantic pre-check — see SKILL.md.

prefixes.description: Repository-specific subsystem, one value per repo (for example `area:cli`, `area:parser`). The prefix is org-wide, the values are not.
